children.name: Data
children.doc: Gif data.

children.name: version
children.doc:
Gif version. There is only 2 Gif version exists. 87a and 89a.
87a have less features and does not support any extensions.
Unknown version is adviced to be interpreted as newest (89a) official version.

children.name: logicalScreenDescriptor
children.doc: Information about logical screen of Gif that provides basic information about Gif.

children.name: globalColorTable
children.doc:
Global color table used for Gif. Present only if Logical Screen Descriptor contained global color table flag.
Note that this color table not always present since frames can contain local color tables that overrides global color table.

children.name: blocks
children.doc: List of Gif data blocks.

children.name: Block
children.doc: Gif data block. Custom blocks are not supported.

children.name: BFrame
children.doc:
Gif frame block.
Note that this block does not contain link to graphic control extension of Frame even if it is present. GraphicControl extension Block commonly present right before frame Block.

children.name: BExtension
children.doc: Additional extension block. This Block does not supported in 87a Gif specification version.

children.name: BEOF
children.doc: End of File block. Represents end of Gif data.

children.name: Extension
children.doc: Extension block contains additional data about Gif image. This block does not supported by 87a version.

children.name: EGraphicControl
children.doc: Graphic Control extension gives additional control over next frame, like frame delay, disposal method, alpha channel and other information.

children.name: EComment
children.doc: Commentary extension. Not show up as any visual, just a text in file.

children.name: EText
children.doc: Text extension. Must work as text rendering on the image, but ignored by all major Gif decoders.

children.name: EApplicationExtension
children.doc: Application extension allow to insert additional application data into Gif. Mostly used app extension is NETSCAPE2.0 looping extension, used to set up amount of loops in frame.

children.name: EUnknown
children.doc: Unknown extension.

children.name: ApplicationExtension
children.doc: Application extension. Mostly used only for one reason - setting up loops count. There is exist other app extensions but they are really rare.

children.name: AENetscapeLooping
children.doc:
NETSCAPE2.0 looping extension. Contains only amount of animation repeats.
Note that there is two NETSCAPE2.0 app extensions for Gif format and the type of extension is stored in first byte of data. Looping extension have ID 1.

children.name: AEUnknown
children.doc: Unknown or unsupported app extension.

children.name: ColorTable
children.doc:
Typical color table for Gif image.
Can contain 2, 4, 8, 16, 32, 64, 128 or 256 colors.
Data stored in RGB format. Information about alpha channel provided by Graohic Control Extension.

children.name: Frame
children.doc:
Single frame of the image.
Actually it's a merge of 3 consequent blocks:
1. Image Descriptor.
Contains frame informations like position, size, existing of local color table and interlaced flag.
2. [Local color table].
Only present if Image Descriptor contains local color table flag. Overrides global color table.
3. Pixel data blocks.
LZW compressed pixel data.

children.name: x
children.doc: X position of image on the Logical Screen

children.name: y
children.doc: Y position of image on the Logical Screen

children.name: width
children.doc: Width of image in pixels

children.name: height
children.doc: Height of image in pixels

children.name: localColorTable
children.doc: Is this image uses local color table?

children.name: interlaced
children.doc:
Is this image written in interlace mode?
Note: The pixel data already deinterlaced and this flag presented only for information purpose (and for Writer when there is one).

children.name: sorted
children.doc: Is local color table sorted in order of decreasing priority?

children.name: localColorTableSize
children.doc: Size of local color table

children.name: pixels
children.doc: Pixel data of frame. Stored as Indexed colors, 1 byte per pixel.

children.name: colorTable
children.doc: Local color table used by frame. Stored as 3-byte RGB colors. If value is null, must be used global color table.

children.name: GraphicControlExtension
children.doc: Graphic Control Extension block, used for setting up disposal method, transparency, delay and user input.

children.name: disposalMethod
children.doc: Disposal method of frame.

children.name: userInput
children.doc:
Is image must wait for user input, before dispose?
This flag may be used by user-defined program but absolutely ignored by any Gif players.

children.name: hasTransparentColor
children.doc: Is image have transparency?

children.name: delay
children.doc:
Delay, before next image appears. Delay is in centiseconds (1 centisecond = 1/100 seconds).
Note: Some players (like FastStone) cut fraction of elapsed time when progressing to next frame which results in small timing error.
Recommended to use `time -= delay` instead of `time = 0`.

children.name: transparentIndex
children.doc: Index in color table that used as transparent.

children.name: PlainTextExtension
children.doc:
Extension for rendering text on Gif logical screen. It does not supported by major Gif decoders.
Font and text size decision is left to decoder. (recommended to decide based on grid/cell size)
Text must be rendered with one character at cell.
It's recommended to replace any characters less than 0x20 and greater than 0xf7 to be rendered as Space (0x20)

children.name: textGridX
children.doc: X position of text grid on Logical Screen.

children.name: textGridY
children.doc: Y position of text grid on Logical Screen.

children.name: textGridWidth
children.doc: Width of text grid in pixels.

children.name: textGridHeight
children.doc: Height of text grid in pixels.

children.name: charCellWidth
children.doc: Width of character cell in text grid.

children.name: charCellHeight
children.doc: Height of character cell in text grid.

children.name: textForegroundColorIndex
children.doc: Foreground/character color index.

children.name: textBackgroundColorIndex
children.doc: Background color index.

children.name: text
children.doc: Text to render.

children.name: LogicalScreenDescriptor
children.doc:
Logical screen descriptor of GIF file.
Contains very basic information about Gif.

children.name: width
children.doc: Width of GIF image in pixels

children.name: height
children.doc: Height of GIF image in pixels

children.name: hasGlobalColorTable
children.doc: Is this file uses global color table?

children.name: colorResolution
children.doc:
Specification:
Number of bits per primary color available
     to the original image, minus 1. This value represents the size of
     the entire palette from which the colors in the graphic were
     selected, not the number of colors actually used in the graphic.
     For example, if the value in this field is 3, then the palette of
     the original image had 4 bits per primary color available to create
     the image.  This value should be set to indicate the richness of
     the original palette, even if not every color from the whole
     palette is available on the source machine.

children.name: sorted
children.doc:
Specification:
Indicates whether the Global Color Table is sorted.
     If the flag is set, the Global Color Table is sorted, in order of
     decreasing importance. Typically, the order would be decreasing
     frequency, with most frequent color first. This assists a decoder,
     with fewer available colors, in choosing the best subset of colors;
     the decoder may use an initial segment of the table to render the
     graphic.

children.name: globalColorTableSize
children.doc: Size of global color table.

children.name: backgroundColorIndex
children.doc: Background color index in global color table

children.name: pixelAspectRatio
children.doc: Factor used to compute an approximation of the aspect ratio of the pixel in the original image.

children.name: Version
children.doc:
Version of Gif file.
The only 2 official versions is GIF87a and GIF89a.

children.name: GIF87a
children.doc:
First version of Gif file format from May 1987.

Note: The checking of unsupported blocks disabled by default to save some time. To enable supported blocks check set `yagp_strict_version_check` debug variable.

children.name: GIF89a
children.doc: Second and actual version of Gif file format from July 1989.

children.name: Unknown
children.doc: Unknown version of Gif file.

children.name: DisposalMethod
children.doc: Disposal method of GIF frame.

children.name: UNSPECIFIED
children.doc:
The disposal method is unspecified. Action on demand of viewer.

Mostly interpreted as NO_ACTION.

children.name: NO_ACTION
children.doc: No action required.

children.name: FILL_BACKGROUND
children.doc:
Fill frame rectangle with background color.

Usage note:
Most renderers clears to transparency instead of filling background color, when frame's transparent color index not equals to background color index.

children.name: RENDER_PREVIOUS
children.doc: Render previous state of gif as it before rendering disposing frame.

children.name: UNDEFINED
children.doc: Reserved disposal methods.

children.name: Tools.hx
getHeader
children.doc: Returns the PNG header informations. Throws an exception if no header found.

children.name: getPalette
children.doc: Return the PNG palette colors, or null if no palette chunk was found

children.name: reverseBytes
children.doc: Converts from BGRA to ARGB and the other way by reversing bytes.

children.name: extractGrey
children.doc: Decode the greyscale PNG data and apply filters, extracting only the grey channel if alpha is present.

children.name: extract32
children.doc: Decode the PNG data and apply filters. By default this will output BGRA low-endian format. You can use the [reverseBytes] function to inverse the bytes to ARGB big-endian format.

children.name: buildGrey
children.doc: Creates PNG data from bytes that contains one bytes (grey values) for each pixel.

children.name: buildIndexed
children.doc: Creates PNG data from bytes that contains a one byte palette index for each pixel and a separate palette with 3 RGB bytes per color.

children.name: buildRGB
children.doc: Creates PNG data from bytes that contains three bytes (R,G and B values) for each pixel.

children.name: build32ARGB
children.doc: Creates PNG data from bytes that contains four bytes in ARGB format for each pixel.

children.name: build32BGRA
children.doc: Creates PNG data from bytes that contains four bytes in BGRA format for each pixel.

children.name: colorMapType
children.doc:
Indicated type of color map.
0 = no color map present.
1 = color map included.
2-127 is reserved by Truevision
128-255 may be used by app developers.

children.name: imageType
children.doc: Image data type.

children.name: colorMapFirstIndex
children.doc:
Index of the first color map entry. Index refers to the starting entry in
loading the color map.

children.name: colorMapLength
children.doc: Total number of color map entries included.

children.name: colorMapEntrySize
children.doc:
Establishes the number of bits per entry. Typically 15, 16, 24 or 32-bit
values are used.

children.name: xOrigin
children.doc:
These bytes specify the absolute horizontal coordinate for the lower left
corner of the image as it is positioned on a display device having an
origin at the lower left of the screen (e.g., the TARGA series).

children.name: yOrigin
children.doc:
These bytes specify the absolute vertical coordinate for the lower left
corner of the image as it is positioned on a display device having an
origin at the lower left of the screen (e.g., the TARGA series).

children.name: width
children.doc: This field specifies the width of the image in pixels.

children.name: height
children.doc: This field specifies the height of the image in pixels.

children.name: bitsPerPixel
children.doc:
This field indicates the number of bits per pixel. This number includes
the Attribute or Alpha channel bits. Common values are 8, 16, 24 and
32 but other pixel depths could be used.

children.name: alphaChannelBits
children.doc:
the number of attribute bits per
pixel. In the case of the TrueVista, these bits
indicate the number of bits per pixel which are
designated as Alpha Channel bits. For the ICB
and TARGA products, these bits indicate the
number of overlay bits available per pixel.

children.name: NoImage
children.doc: There is no image data present

children.name: UncompressedColorMapped
children.doc: Uncompressed image with color-map usage

children.name: UncompressedTrueColor
children.doc: True-color uncompressed image

children.name: UncompressedBlackAndWhite
children.doc: Black-and-White uncompresed image

children.name: RunLengthColorMapped
children.doc: Run-length encoded image with color-map usage

children.name: RunLengthTrueColor
children.doc: Run-length encoded true-color image

children.name: RunLengthBlackAndWhite
children.doc: Run-length encoded black-and-white image

children.doc: Unknown type

children.name: extract32
children.doc:
Extracts BGRA pixel data from TGA file.
If `extractAlpha` is true, alpha channel will be applied to image, mostly resulting in completely transparent image.
Otherwise alpha will be forced to 0xFF.
If image does not contain image data, 0-filled array returned.

children.name: extractAlpha
children.doc:
Extracts alpha channel from TGA file.
If image does not contain image data, 0-filled array returned.

children.name: extractGrey
children.doc:
Extracts grey channel from TGA file.
If image does not contains image data 0-filled array returned.
If image is not black-and-white, error thrown.
